author: Ryan Shirley
description:
I've spent the last decade traveling Europe and I want to share with you my favorite places. Enjoy this travel guide featuring Europe's incredible destinations. From the enchanting scenery of the Alps, to crystal clear waters of the Mediterranean, Europe  remains unmated to the rest of the world. I put my heart, soul, and several years of hard work into this video and I can't wait to share it with you.
